## History

Pierre Aronnax, an Assistant Professor at the Museum of Natural History in [Paris](../codex/places.md#paris), joins an expedition aboard the frigate [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln) after publishing an article proposing that a mysterious sea phenomenon is a giant narwhal. During the search in the [Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific), he debates the creature's existence with harpooner [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) before a violent midnight collision with the glowing beast throws Aronnax into the ocean. Rescued and trapped inside the submarine [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) alongside [Ned](../character/ned-land.md) and his servant [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), Aronnax meets Captain Nemo, who grants them freedom restricted to the ship while declaring they will remain prisoners forever. [Nemo](../character/nemo.md) takes Aronnax on extensive tours of the vessel's engineering, art collections, and library, taking him on various undersea excursions including hunting in the forests of [Crespo](../codex/places.md#crespo) Island and visiting pearl fisheries off [Ceylon](../codex/places.md#ceylon). Following an emergency drugging during a secret operation, Aronnax attends a coral cemetery burial for a slain crew member and later witnesses [Nemo](../character/nemo.md) send gold to a Greek diver. Trapped by ice during a journey to the [South Pole](../codex/places.md#south-pole), Aronnax accompanies [Nemo](../character/nemo.md) ashore as the captain claims the pole, and he later survives a near-fatal oxygen shortage before the submarine breaks free. When [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) pressures him to seek their release off the [American](../codex/factions.md#american) coast, Aronnax confronts [Nemo](../character/nemo.md), but the captain firmly refuses to ever let the prisoners leave.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P0](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P8](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P14](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P19](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P6](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0006), +62 more_

## Relationships

### [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aronnax--conseil.md)

[Conseil](../character/conseil.md) is Aronnax's devoted servant who obediently packs their belongings and accompanies him on the expedition aboard the [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln). After being thrown into the ocean and captured, the two remain traveling companions locked together aboard the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus). Though they face captivity alongside [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) continues to follow Aronnax's lead as they adjust to their life under Captain Nemo's command.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P0](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P12](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P27](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0027), +21 more_

- Comrade of — traveling companion on board the Nautilus  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIII THE BLACK RIVER P19](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0019), [v2 CHAPTER VIII VIGO BAY P11](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0011), [v2 CHAPTER X THE SUBMARINE COAL-MINES P27](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0027), +3 more</sub>

### [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aronnax--ned-land.md)

Aronnax initially meets [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) aboard the [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln), where he uses scientific arguments to debate the existence of the sea monster with the skeptical harpooner. Their bond deepens after being thrown overboard and taken captive together aboard the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus). As fellow prisoners, they share the ordeal of confinement and attempt to navigate Captain Nemo's strict rule, though Ned's fiery temper sometimes creates tension, such as when he attacks a steward out of hunger.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P6](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P11](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P12](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0012), +25 more_
